name: row-text cache dropped with null instead of undefined
why: Reverts the fix to exactly the shipped-on-branch code. _cachedColText() treats `undefined` as 'not cached' and recomputes; _relDropRowTextCache() wrote `null`, which is not the same value, so a collapse POISONED the entry instead of invalidating it. The next matchOnly pass then read `null` back as though it were cached text and testRowMatch() threw on cellText.toLowerCase(), aborting runFilter()'s row loop part-way — so _highlightRelCellIcons() never ran and a 📊 relationship entry picked after a collapse/expand cycle left its icons un-outlined. The spec must fail at the outline assertion and on the uncaught page error.
grep: the reported sequence: pick, clear, filter another column, collapse, expand, pick again
